Product Updates

What we shipped

Analytics  •  April/May 2026

The Data Science team completed Phase 1 of a new clinical informatics initiative for UWH, working with up to 10 years of Athena data to uncover meaningful insights across the maternity population.

Across two presentations, the team covered the full UWH patient population (maternity analytics, gynecological cohorts, outcomes, and affiliate variation) then shifted to demonstrating what clinical intelligence looks like in action: identifying high-opportunity care centers and understanding maternal risk patterns across affiliates.

The most compelling takeaway? Many at-risk pregnancies are already UWH patients, creating a real opportunity to intervene before a patient even becomes pregnant.

  • Clinical Informatics Phase 1 Additional Information
Technology  •  April 2026

One of the more exciting UI improvements in the pipeline is a reimagined filter experience for Discover. The current filter popup has been showing its limits — too many filter categories, slow to open, and not built to scale. The team went back to the drawing board to fix that.

The result is a filter "flyout" that slides in from the right side of the screen. It's faster to open, easier to navigate, and built to handle as many filter categories as we need. Saved filter groups also got an upgrade — they now live inside the flyout itself, making it quicker to jump back into a previously saved view.

  • Discover New Filter Experience Additional Information

Lindsay's Process Corner

From the process desk

Release Calendar Update

We're making a change to our release schedule, effective immediately.

Previously, we released on the last Friday of the sprint. Going forward, releases will move to the Friday after the sprint ends.

What this means:

— All dev work and testing in QA must be completed by the last Friday of the sprint

— The following week is a freeze week — no new code goes in

— That freeze week is dedicated to final validation testing in UAT across Product, Analytics, ClinOps, and CS teams

— Release happens the Friday after the sprint closes

The goal here is to give everyone a clean, focused window to validate before anything goes to production.
